title: 4.4 There Is and There Are
unit_outcome: Locate familiar things and describe a short supported routine using known subjects, simple present chunks, days, and clock times.
goal: Use there is for one thing and there are for two or more things in familiar rooms and locations.
grammar_function: There is + one singular noun; There are + number/plural noun. Location phrases use only 4.3 prepositions.
prerequisite: 4.2 home objects, 4.3 location phrases, Unit 2 numbers and regular plural forms.
speaking_outcome: Repeat three there is and three there are sentences with clear singular/plural agreement.
